register.labelZh: GO BACK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GO BACK Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: go back 可以表示兩個人、家庭或群體已相識多年。；go back on something 可以描述某人違背承諾或協議。；go back over something 可以用來表示再次查看筆記、事情經過、指示或之前的工作。；go back to something 可以幫助你在討論中重新談及之前的問題、構思或主題。
register.summaryEn: Go back can show that two people, families or groups have known each other for a long time. Go back on something helps you describe a person who fails to keep a promise or agreement. Go back over something can be used when you review notes, events, instructions or earlier work. Go back to something helps you return to an earlier question, idea or subject in a discussion.
contextsZh: 自然地回到較早前的內容
contextsEn: Talk clearly about promises and trust
Return smoothly to an earlier point

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Notice what follows each expression: go back on a promise go back over the notes go back to the first point When go back describes a long relationship, go back is the core expression. A time phrase may provide additional information: We go back a long way. We go back to our school days.
